title: Ghazi University Dera Ghazi Khan Second Amendment Ordinance 2015

sections.shortTitle: Ghazi University Dera Ghazi Khan Second Amendment Ordinance 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXX OF 2015
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2015
GHAZI
UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015
An Ordinance further to amend the Ghazi University,
Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary 29th September, 2015]
No. Legis:
13-46/2011 (P-1), dated 29-9-2015.---The following Ordnance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
It is necessary to amend the Ghazi
University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012 (XXIX of 2012)
for excluding Ghazi Khan Medical College from the purview of the University,
for provision of option to Government employees and for other purposes.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is
not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred
under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution or the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be cited as the Ghazi University, Dera
Ghazi Khan (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.
(2) It than come into force at once.

Amendment in section 3 of the Act XXIX of 2012

ORDINANCE XXX OF 2015
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2015
GHAZI
UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015
An Ordinance further to amend the Ghazi University,
Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary 29th September, 2015]
No. Legis:
13-46/2011 (P-1), dated 29-9-2015.---The following Ordnance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
It is necessary to amend the Ghazi
University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012 (XXIX of 2012)
for excluding Ghazi Khan Medical College from the purview of the University,
for provision of option to Government employees and for other purposes.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is
not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred
under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution or the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:
2. Amendment in section 3 of the Act XXIX
of 2012.---(1) In the Ghazi University, Dere
Ghazi Khan Act, 2012 (XXIX of 2012), in section 3:
(a) for
subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:
(1) Government Post Graduate College for Boys, Dera Ghazi Khan, College of Agriculture, Dera Ghazi Khan Campus of the University or Agriculture,
Faisalabad and Dera Ghazi Khan Sub-Campus of Bahauddin Zakariya University,
Multan shall be reconstituted as the Ghazi University, Dera
Ghazi Khan in accordance with the provisions of this Act";
(b) for subsection (6), the following shall
be substituted:
(6) Any property owned or possessed and all
rights and all interests held or enjoyed by, and all liabilities subsisting
against Government Post Graduate College for Boys, Dera
Ghazi Khan, College of Agriculture, Dera Ghazi Khan
Campus of the University of Agriculture, Faisalabad and Dera
Ghazi Khan Sub-Campus of Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan shall stand transferred to the
University. ;
(c) for subsection (7), the following shall
be substituted:
(7) All employees, regular or contact serving
in College of Agriculture, Dera Ghazi Khan Campus of
the University of Agriculture, Faisalabad and Dera
Ghazi Khan Sub-Campus of Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan immediately before
establishment of the University shall stand absorbed in the service of the
University, except such employees who are working in the said College or
Sub-Campus on deputation."; and
(d) subsection
(8) shall be renumbered as subsection (10) and after subsection (7), the
following subsections (8) and (9) shall be inserted:
"(8) All employees of the Government,
regular or contract, serving the Government Post Graduate College for Boys, Dera Ghazi Khan immediately before establishment of the
University shall be considered on deputation with the University but they shall
not be entitled to any deputation allowance.
(9) Subject to the criteria notified by the
University, an employee of the Government on deputation with the University
under subsection (8) may, within one year from the date of the notification of
the criteria, opt for absorption in the service of the University as a one time option."
